meta.title: SunmoonAI Admin
meta.description: A production Next.js administration foundation paired with a dedicated FastAPI Admin Backend.

public.title: A secure and auditable governance console foundation
public.description: Identity, authorization, session, data access and release boundaries are governed by explicit contracts.

errors.notFoundDescription: The requested page does not exist or is no longer available.
errors.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not allow this administration capability.

auth.logoutFailed: Sign out failed. Please try again.
auth.loginSubtitle: Authentication and session state belong to the paired FastAPI Admin Backend.
auth.loginCasdoorHint: The browser never stores provider tokens; authorization is converted into a backend-owned session.
auth.continueToDashboard: Already signed in? Open the governance console
auth.errorAuthFailed: Sign-in failed. Verify the Casdoor Admin application, callback URL and backend logs.
auth.errorNoCode: No authorization code was returned. Start sign-in again.
auth.errorOAuthGeneric: Authorization was denied or cancelled. Please try again.
auth.signupSuccessHint: Sign-up succeeded. Sign in to enter this site.

nav.governanceDescription: P0-007E will add navigation, authorization, CRUD, audit and shared tooling on this foundation.

knowbots.title: Expert drafts
knowbots.intro: Turn submitted ideas into drafts, check every rule source, and start tests here; a passing draft is delivered to knowmart. The method comes only from the user (C-L1); reports only cover whether it runs correctly (C-L5).
knowbots.noPermission: This account has no admin rights (the admin or operator role is required). Sign out and sign in with an administrator account.

q.steps: What are the steps, and which rule decides each step?
q.outputs: What does the output look like?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

knowbots.noDatasets: This user has not uploaded any data.

questions.title: Questions to answer
questions.intro: The test stopped where a person has to decide; it continues once answered. We answer approvals; questions and ask-before prompts go to the user first (C-L1). If one is only about how to run, say why in one line and answer it ourselves; our answers are not the user's confirmation and are not written back to the cases or the rule sources.
questions.withUser: With the user, waiting for an answer.
questions.judgementHint: Anything that is an investment judgement (basis, trade-off, threshold) goes back to the user.
questions.takeReason: Why this is only about how to run (one line)

knowbots.answeredTitle: Questions answered during tests (only the user's go into the next draft's rule sources)
knowbots.adminOnly: Only an admin can do this (create drafts, review rule sources, deliver, return). Operators can view, start tests and answer how-to-run questions.

next.none: Next: paste the expert manifest to create the first draft
next.testing: Testing: press “Refresh result” now and then
next.failed: Did not pass: read the result above, fix the manifest and create the next draft
next.passed: Passed, but delivery failed: retry delivery
next.revise: New revision: paste the new manifest to create the next draft

knowbots.reviewHint: Every rule must match the user’s own words (C-L1). Read them all before confirming.
knowbots.startHint: The budget is split evenly across cases; the timeout is shared by all cases of the run and excludes time spent waiting for answers.
knowbots.testingHint: A case shows up in the result only when it has finished; while it runs the result is empty.
